subject: West Coast KBP concept-only detached A600 on a representative Greater Sacramento residential lot

a600.rule: Do not invent assemblies, junctions, structure, MEP, code compliance, construction readiness, or site fit.

lot.type: representative Greater Sacramento single-family rear yard; not a real or identifiable parcel
characteristics: dry-summer California daylight and restrained drought-aware planting
credible fence/property-edge cues without legal-boundary meaning
flat-to-gently-graded usable yard without survey or drainage claims
ordinary mature neighborhood scale; no resort landscape or wilderness setting

physical_truth.existing_house_relationship: Camera begins inside the existing main house, looking through a credible full-height opening into the rear yard. Foreground structure, yard and detached A600 remain three legible depth planes; A600 is visibly subordinate in scale.
physical_truth.adu_placement: Rear-yard detached object with visible circulation and open-yard breathing room; no numeric setback or property-line claim. Never intersect the existing house, fence, mature tree, or implied access path.
physical_truth.construction_continuity: Use restrained reversible cues such as a clean planning table/overlay, compact material samples, or one orderly work-zone trace. No workers, unsafe activity, heavy equipment spectacle, or claim that the depicted project was built.

cameras.purpose: First-frame physical truth and continuous inhabited space
cameras.position: Inside main house, 6-12 ft from the opening; axis oblique enough to retain an interior jamb/ceiling/floor cue.
cameras.composition: Existing-house foreground 20-35% of frame; yard is connective middle plane; A600 occupies 18-30% of frame width and is not merged with copy.
refusals: A600 larger than the existing-house read

cameras.purpose: R2 material, landscape and construction credibility
cameras.position: At or just beyond the house opening, maintaining a traceable reverse relationship to C01.
cameras.composition: Three-quarter A600 view with footprint and gable legible; retain yard access and a main-house edge.
refusals: portfolio glamour shot with no lot
material macro presented as sample truth

cameras.purpose: Stable A600 object for the later R3 transition
cameras.position: Deterministic continuation from C02, centered on the same A600 massing anchor.
cameras.composition: A600 silhouette and front-left origin remain stable while plan lines may register; UI appears only after physical object truth.
refusals: geometry morph that changes the A600

light.intent: Natural late-morning California daylight, airy rather than sunset-cinematic; warm neutral interior bounce and controlled exterior highlights.
light.solar_direction: side/back-side light that reveals gable, siding rhythm and landscape depth without silhouetting the A600
light.color_boundary: No exact physical color or manufacturer colorimetry claim without a verified sample and calibrated capture.

materials.a600: Use source-neutral warm mineral/stucco or clearly conceptual siding; James Hardie names may guide attributed intent only, not texture or local-availability truth.
materials.existing_house: Quiet warm mineral/painted wood surfaces, visibly distinct from A600; do not copy a specific property.
materials.hardscape: Ordinary patio/threshold material with believable scale and no brand claim.
materials.landscape: Drought-aware mixed planting and restrained lawn/groundcover; no species or irrigation claim unless independently sourced.
materials.truth_rule: Every texture/HDRI/mesh used later requires its own admitted ledger row or must be authored procedurally as CUSTOM-3D.

responsive_frames.crop_safe: A600 and its yard breathing room occupy the right 54-62%; preserve an interior jamb/floor/ceiling cue and reserve the left 34-40% for editorial copy.
Center the three depth planes; keep A600 fully inside the middle 70% width and reserve a calm upper/left band for compact copy.
Use a dedicated portrait camera/framing, not a blind desktop center crop. A600 occupies the lower-middle 55-75% width; retain one vertical opening edge, yard plane and sky/light separation.

publication_disclosure: Conceptual A600 visualization on a representative property — not a completed project, parcel-specific fit, approved plan, permit, price, schedule, or buildability conclusion.

join_gate.reason: No rights-complete real California existing-house/backyard source is admitted, and the current Adobe composite has no explicit publication/derivative license grant in repository evidence.
join_gate.minimum_clearing_evidence: Either (a) an owner-signed photography/source record with property/model releases, exact file digest, allowed publication/derivative scope and crop limits, or (b) a fully source-ledgered CUSTOM-3D environment whose every constituent asset is owned or license-admitted.
